response.text: {"items": [{"text": "Bid compliance: send the proposal by e-mail to the Trust's office as one document of no more than 15 pages by 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12, ensure all personal data is kept in the United Kingdom, and achieve system go-live by 2027-06-30.", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-0001", "REQ-0007", "REQ-0011"], "basis": "The instructions state the format, page limit, deadline, data location requirement, and go-live date. Compliance with these criteria is achieved by directly matching proposal delivery and hosting architecture to the requirements."}, {"text": "Donor management: hold a record for each donor with their contact details and the history of their gifts, and record each donor's consent to be contacted by e-mail, by post and by telephone, with the date the consent was given.", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-0002", "REQ-0003"], "basis": "The system architecture incorporates dedicated data structures for donor profiles, gift histories, and granular contact consents with timestamps."}, {"text": "Volunteer management: record the hours each volunteer gives to each club, and send each volunteer a reminder two days before every session they are booked on.", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-0004", "REQ-0005"], "basis": "Volunteer hours and booking schedules are tracked in the database, triggering automated reminders two days prior to sessions."}, {"text": "Training services: train the Trust's staff before the system goes live.", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-0010"], "basis": "Training sessions will be scheduled and completed prior to the 2027-06-30 go-live date."}, {"text": "Data migration: import the Trust's existing donor spreadsheet without manual retyping as part of the implementation option.", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-0006"], "basis": "An import utility script will process the existing spreadsheet format."}], "unmapped_requirement_ids": ["REQ-0008"], "open_questions": [{"text": "Should the optional mobile app for volunteers be priced separately, and what specific features must it include?", "requirement_ids": ["REQ-0008"]}]}
